headline_hook: Claude Cracks Post-Quantum Crypto While MCP Goes Stateless and Google Ships Managed Agents

pick_of_the_day.thesis: Claude independently discovering a practical attack on a NIST post-quantum candidate isn't a benchmark stunt — it's the first credible evidence that AI can do original security research, and that rewrites the threat model for every cryptographic standard still in review.

model_literacy.relevance: MCP's shift from persistent WebSocket connections to stateless HTTP directly solves the load-balancer and CDN compatibility problems that blocked production MCP deployments — understanding this transport distinction explains why the spec change matters more than any new feature.

items.title: Anthropic Ships MCP 2026-07-28 in Claude — First Major Platform on the Stateless Spec
items.angle: First mover advantage: by adopting the stateless MCP spec before competitors, Anthropic is setting the de facto implementation standard that every other platform will benchmark against.
items.key_fact: Claude is the first major AI platform to implement the new stateless MCP transport specification

items.title: Google Expands Gemini Managed Agents with 3.6 Flash and Lifecycle Hooks
items.angle: Google's lifecycle hooks for managed agents signal the real battleground has shifted from model quality to production agent infrastructure — whoever owns the orchestration layer owns the developer.

items.title: Allen AI Launches OlmoEarth for Planetary-Scale Geospatial Inference

items.title: MCP Spec Goes Stateless: The Biggest Transport Overhaul Since Launch
items.angle: Dropping WebSocket state requirements removes the single biggest ops headache for teams trying to deploy MCP servers behind real infrastructure.
items.key_fact: Stateless HTTP transport replaces stateful WebSocket connections in the MCP specification

items.title: Claude Independently Discovers a Real Cryptographic Attack on Post-Quantum Candidate HAWK-256
items.angle: This isn't reproducing a known exploit — Claude found a novel practical vulnerability in a NIST post-quantum candidate, crossing the line from AI-assisted to AI-originated security research.
items.key_fact: Practical key-recovery attack independently discovered by Claude against HAWK-256, a NIST post-quantum cryptography candidate

items.title: Anthropic Open-Sources the HAWK-256 Attack Code for Reproducibility
